raw_segments.text: It is much the same, therefore, as if one should compare an inanimate with an animate
For the badness of that which has no principle of origination is always less harmful.
Now intellect is a principle of origination.
A similar case would be the comparing injustice and an unjust man together.
For in different ways each is the worst.
A bad man would produce ten thousand times as much harm as a bad brute.
